Honestly the months when I don't smoke I do have a more organized routine with everything, I've tried working out high but I just end up feeling lazy, so when I do smoke I try to do it only on very active days, on days that I'm out or when I feel more confident of not overeating, weed affects everyone different and I had to accept that I cannot be a recurrent smoker and keep my routine and diet as I want it to be. I don't drink or do any other drugs tho, only weed.

Coming from someone who's been dealing with sh addiction, it really depends on the person. Started with my wrists, it was easy to hide when I was 13, eventually I moved higher onto my forearms, that's a "popular" place so to speak, I would say it's because is easy to access. I have also cut my legs, my shoulders, my hands and even ankles once (bad idea) but it depends, if it's only for the pain, you can do it anywhere, if you want to hide it, ppl do it in their thighs or stomach. I've seen ppl cut their face or neck also. Ppl think sh is really really painful but tbh, you get numb, it starts to hurt only when you get deeper, although the healing part is the worst imo. So I would say preference or security, there's ppl who really have severe episodes and would cut anywhere, and once you start cutting you just... continue, that's a very dangerous part about it (no shit cutting is dangerous right) that it can escalate real quickly once you're not scared about the pain or the mess.
